description: Line budgets are OFF by default since 0.6.0 — every key in config.json -> budgets defaults to null, because a document is as long as its content honestly requires. The mechanism stays for the project that genuinely wants a ceiling on one file, and this case guards that it still works when asked for: the fixture sets budgets.spec = 150 in its own .rush/config.json, and validate-artifacts.sh must report the over-budget spec.md. It also pins the default: the same file, checked from a project that sets no budget, must NOT be reported.

given.scenario: Fixture project containing specs/001-fixture/spec.md, deliberately 182 lines, with .rush/config.json setting budgets.spec = 150. The no-budget half runs the same validator from a fixture that sets none.
